source.detail: Remove created_at and updated_at fields from Zero Trust organization

spec_evidence.checked: Release notes (DB raw_excerpt complete) list one breaking-relevant line among otherwise additive features: commit 4656a4e removes created_at and updated_at from the Zero Trust organization type, driven by a composite API spec update. No successor timestamp fields are introduced in the same release. The removal is at the generated-type level following the upstream spec, so readers of organization.created_at / organization.updated_at lose the fields on upgrade.

fix.migration_guide: Delete reads of created_at / updated_at on Zero Trust organization objects (client.zeroTrust.organizations.*) and any downstream display or sorting logic keyed on them, or guard with optional chaining and a null fallback where the surrounding code must keep shape. This follows the remove-discontinued-field-read precedent (vercel dheCipherSuite): the fields were dropped from the spec with no replacement, so removing the read is the mechanically safe mend. Confidence medium because sort/display call sites may need a substitute ordering decision from the owner.
fix.example_after: const createdAt = org.created_at ?? null; // field removed upstream in v5.2.0; decide replacement ordering key
